nodes.name: parity_action_space
nodes.premise: Assert policy outputs == env action count before any training. Drift evidence: PolicyNet 7 vs decode 0-8 hid brake actions; fixed to 9. Dota2: match hybrid action-space size. Rocket: match gimbal/throttle bins.

nodes.name: clean_eval_selection
nodes.premise: Never rank on noisy rollouts. Re-eval top-K candidates deterministic (noise 0, 3 eps); elites/saves/early-stop on clean fitness. Drift evidence: 40pct-noise fitness claimed 1.5 laps, true policy 0 laps.

nodes.name: diversity_pressure
nodes.premise: Entropy and unique-action tiebreak in rank key demotes single-action collapse. Drift evidence: all-action-6 wall crash at 246,142. Key shape is task, activity, survival, unique, entropy, minus risk.

nodes.name: activity_gate
nodes.premise: Rank activity before survival so parking or timeout sitting cannot win. Drift evidence: brake-sit 4000 steps outranked movers until dist metric added. Dota2: reward turtling only with map control. Rocket: hovering is not landing.

nodes.name: reward_asymmetry
nodes.premise: Terminal failure penalty must exceed max achievable bonus or suicide loops pay. Drift evidence: lap 750 vs off-track 1000, no double bonus. Rocket: crash penalty must exceed landing bonus intermediates.

nodes.name: verify_standard
nodes.premise: Claim results only from deterministic eval with trajectory log: noise 0, fixed seed, per-step CSV with positions, crash-point summary. Drift evidence: traj_eval.csv exposed 0-lap truth behind 1.5-lap noisy claim.

nodes.name: ci_hygiene
nodes.premise: Training entry must be CI-safe: no input prompts, model paths anchored to code dir, seed and duration flags, stdout guard under pytest. Drift evidence: train hygiene v1 plus viz-seconds auto-exit.

nodes.name: rocket_parity_target_obs
nodes.premise: Rocket: 11D obs = 9D env + rel-target dx,dy/1000; assert policy outs == 2 env actions before training. Reuse for drift: obs must carry goal vector, parity assert catches silent dim mismatch.

nodes.name: rocket_clean_eval_hover_gate
nodes.premise: Rocket: clean eval fixed target (0,300) seed 0 x3eps, rank (success, displacement, unique, entropy); displacement gate kills hover-parking like drift brake-sit; traj_last.csv per-step verify standard. Reuse for drift: same rank shape.

nodes.name: rocket_early_stop_stall
nodes.premise: Rocket: eval every 50 eps prints clean/best/stale counter; early-stop after patience=4 stale evals (200 eps) with min_delta=1.0. Mirrors drift early-stop 8. Reuse: stalled noisy training wastes compute.

nodes.name: rocket_liftoff_discovery
nodes.premise: Rocket T/W~1.06: unbiased policy (thr 0.49) never lifts, disp 0 forever. Fix: throttle-bias +2.0 (prior 0.88) + fuel curriculum (35pct early to full) + liftoff/progress shaping + entropy 0.01. Random policy then disp 78-2232m, 2/5 success. Reuse: check actuator-vs-load margin first; bias init + load curriculum beats more episodes.

nodes.name: forfeit_accrued_on_termination
nodes.premise: When a terminal penalty cannot exceed the accruable bonus, forfeit the accrued gains at termination instead of raising the fine: fatal episodes net negative regardless of farming rate.

nodes.name: ppo_gae_double_count
nodes.premise: PPO GAE bug: delta = r + g*(l + Vnext) - V double-counts lambda-return (coeff 1.93>1, advantages 5e52, inf in float32, NaN weights). Correct: delta = r + g*Vnext - V; A += delta + g*lam*A. Masked because Python floats hold 1e52 while float32 infs. Always assert advantages finite + bounded after GAE. Found via per-step trace.

nodes.name: stagnation_kill_lesson
nodes.premise: Kill episodes with no new checkpoint for N ticks and count as death: caps survivor-longevity cost explosion (4.8min vs 13.9min per gen) and forces coverage.

nodes.name: curriculum_gate_lesson
nodes.premise: Start the pool on the easiest track; expand once clean laps cross a threshold. Specialists that brake-park hard tracks never survive the gate.

nodes.name: parallel_agent_eval_lesson
nodes.premise: Agent rollouts parallelize over population (one process per core, per-(gen,agent) seeds, one torch thread each). Near-linear speedup, zero numeric coupling.

nodes.name: checkpoint_resume_lesson
nodes.premise: Save full population+counters+pool stage every generation; resume by index. Decouple run length from wall-clock approval: probe N gens, analyze, resume.

nodes.name: common: measure transfer never the training metric
